object_description: two-level cruciform school volume with a covered courtyard
design_condition: The cruciform volume is placed in the garden along the western plot edge, continuing the village fabric between built area and fields while organizing the surrounding garden into linked outdoor rooms.

positive.statement: The simple and effective concept recognizes and affirms the built limits of the surrounding neighborhood.
The school naturally integrates into the continuity of the built fabric between village and fields while measuring its impact.
The proposed extension by elevation continues the established logic efficiently and economically.
The covered courtyard is skillfully integrated into the building envelope and functions as a real entrance porch.
The simple S-shaped distribution system provides a balanced sequence of thresholds and varied spaces.
Four large windows across three orientations guarantee high-quality light in every classroom.
The identical, homogeneous character of the four facades presents a calm relationship to the near and distant environment.
The schoolyard, playground and basketball court are qualified as linked streets and squares, affirming the suburban character.
The proposal achieves a precise balance between the theme, site constraints, spatial richness and constructive simplicity.

negative.statement: The jury regrets the chosen parking location.
The northern access to the site lacks assertiveness in its design.
